title: California Attorney General asks FBI to investigate Newton

tellings.quote: On April 25th, 1951, he had the California Attorney General's office contact the FBI to look into Newton, questioning his claims of conducting secret government research and accusing him of being in on a hoax.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that on April 25, 1951, a man named JP Khan had California's Attorney General's office, the state's top law office, contact the FBI, the US federal police, to look into a man named Silus Newton. According to Michels, the complaint questioned Newton's claims of doing secret government research and accused him of being part of a hoax, and the matter appears in FBI files on Newton. Michels tells it in an episode about a claimed crash of a craft carrying alien bodies, where Newton's credibility matters to the story.
